reason: I like the idea of having all my bank slips in one place, but the Shortcut setup sounds like a chore, and I'd have to trust a budgeting app with my bank slip text. I'd rather try the free manual tracking first and see if I keep using it.
objection: The setup looks complicated even with a video, and I don't really know whether 'encrypted' means they can't see my financial data.
would_change_my_mind: If the setup took about five minutes on my phone, and I could turn it off and delete my data without fuss.
